title: Shock-robust cartel screening for platform markets
description: Curated excerpts support a gap around distinguishing collusive synchronization from platform-wide shocks.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: The closest screening method relies on stable demand, while the identification note warns shocks can mimic collusion.
why_it_matters: False accusations in cartel screening are costly and identification failures undermine evidence.
possible_research_questions: Can shock controls reduce false positives in platform cartel screens?
minimum_experiment_needed: Compare a synchronization screen against shock-adjusted controls on synthetic platform market panels.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: Economics prior work may already contain robust identification designs outside this fixture.
